paguṇa:
[Pa+guṇa+a]  CL=8 Pa + Guna (Etymology and Meaning):
The word "paguna" is derived from
- Pa (in various ways) + Guna (quality)
- Meaning: That which is repeatedly practiced or cultivated
1. That which should be studied and practiced
a) Well-versed, memorized (regarding scriptures etc.)
b) Repeatedly developed or cultivated (regarding mind, jhana etc.)
2. One who has studied and mastered; skilled, experienced person
3. Time of study or practice
4. One possessing primary or essential qualities
5. Free from disease; healthy
6. Straight, upright, direct
[Reference: Anuti.3.257, Thoma.]
